people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
translations.bsb: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
translations.asv: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and ye dishonor me.
